# Contextual carrier input and type token

One invariant carrier input and one invariant/covariant unary token bind the
same Object-bounded method formal as a complete invariant result. Fixed contexts
bind no formal. Public, package nested and virtual entries retain actual calls,
input references and opaque returned objects.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK profiles compare live list mutations,
returned-input and distinct result identities, field snapshots, ignored calls,
late casts, null order and exact checked/Error identity. Independent wrong
programs must fail the observer and compiler metadata remains unchanged.
